title: AudioLib migration HTTP rules
description: Admin endpoints: POST /admin/api/migration/{start,pause,resume,cancel,rollback}, GET /admin/api/migration/status; body per migration-report.schema.json. While a migration is not idle/done every response carries `x-audiolib-migration: <state>`. Reads (list, main search, playback, artwork) stay 200. A path-only search (scope=path) before the path table is ready → 503 {error_code: migration_in_progress}, Retry-After: 30. Scope all (`scope=all`) → 200 with main-table results only and `x-audiolib-path-search: unavailable`; this fallback retains the main search's exact total_count. Once ready, nonempty all/path searches use limit + 1 lookahead: total_count is an observed prefix lower bound without a cursor or a page-local suffix count with a cursor; next_cursor, omitted on the last page, is the authoritative continuation. Internal has_more is not an HTTP response field. These descriptions preserve the existing response shape and ale-s9-cld1-t3-m2-p1-a1-sd1 format. During `switching`, writes (vendor import, annotations) → 503 {error_code: migration_switching}, Retry-After: 30; reads 200. Second start while running → 409 with the report body (error_code already_running).

rules.when: path-only search before path table ready
scope all search before path table ready
any response while migration state is not idle/done
